Trimmed copies of upstream data for offline tests.

- `pldb.json`: 10 records from https://pldb.io/pldb.json (public domain). Haskell's
  `influencedBy` was set for lineage tests, and a planted `wikipedia_summary` checks that
  share-alike fields are never ingested.
- `languages.yml`: 7 entries from GitHub Linguist `lib/linguist/languages.yml` (MIT,
  Copyright (c) 2017 GitHub, Inc.).
